entities.name: Ryō Terakado
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ryo Terakado  is a Japanese violinist and conductor who specializes in historically informed performance. He also plays the viola, viola d'amore and violoncello da spalla. He has been teaching at the Royal Conservatory of The Hague and the Toho Gakuen School of Music.
